description: A classic Georgian red wine that embodies the essence of our ancient winemaking traditions. This Saperavi offers rich, full-bodied character with exceptional depth and complexity.
tastingNotes: Deep ruby color with intense aromatics of dark berries, blackcurrants, and subtle spice. Full-bodied with firm tannins, excellent acidity, and a long, elegant finish with hints of dark chocolate and tobacco.

vinification.fermentation: Traditional qvevri fermentation with indigenous yeasts

description: A refined white wine showcasing the noble Rkatsiteli grape in its purest form. Crisp, elegant, and beautifully balanced with distinctive minerality.
